sentences.en: The more variables you have, the less predictable the results become.
sentences.zh: 变量越多，结果就越不可预测。

sentences.en: It was predictable that this would happen.
sentences.zh: 这件事的发生是可以预见的。

sentences.en: The story was predictable, but enchanting nonetheless.
sentences.zh: 故事虽然老套，但依然令人着迷。

senses.zh: 可预言〔预报〕的 - 不出所料的，可以想见的；平庸的；墨守成规的；毫无想像力的 -
